summary: Implemented S5 scene import and validated overlay documents; final VM gate passes.
body:
Changed files:

- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/properties.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/mod.rs` — module and reexports only.
- `crates/interchange/src/lib.rs` — Scene import dispatch and `ImportOptions.lenient` only.

Public API:

```rust
pub fn import(
    bytes: &[u8],
    opts: &ImportOptions,
) -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;

pub struct Overlay {
    pub item: ItemId,
    pub path: String,
    pub document: Vec<u8>,
}
```

Reexported as `scene::import` and `scene::Overlay`. `ImportOptions.lenient: bool` defaults to false, including deserialization. Generic dispatch refuses overlays unless lenient; lenient dispatch removes their clips and media items and reports the loss.

Design and integration notes:

- Timing, layout and paint order come from S4. Video edges snap with round-half-even; linked audio retains unsnapped edges. Reports include changed-edge counts and maximum error. Holds use native frame holds; reverse clips account for FilmCraft’s exclusive source-end convention.
- Native sequence duration is derived from clips. A disabled transparent duration carrier preserves trailing blank time, while `mark_out` retains the exact project duration. See `crates/project/src/lib.rs`, `Sequence::duration`.
- Background behavior follows vendored `scene-render.xsd`, `projectType`: solid matte, gradient first-stop fallback with stop opacity, or no matte for transparent.
- Key interpolation follows XSD `keyType` and `animateType`: outgoing interpolation, default interpolation, resolved time bases, and distinct CSS versus temporal/spatial controls. CSS curves use the closest supported interpolation; unsupported handles and independent-axis approximation are reported.
- FilmCraft lacks absolute source-time remap curves. Remaps retain the first affine segment with a report; freeze sampling is retained. See XSD `layerType` and `crates/project/src/effect.rs`.
- S4 does not expose fitted-content transforms or a flattenable world matrix for animated children under transformed parents. These limitations are explicitly reported; local Motion properties are retained.
- Image-sequence duration follows XSD `imageSequenceAssetType`. Its path pattern is retained and reported for engine relinking; this pure importer performs no file enumeration.
- Overlay documents preserve version, project settings, ancestor clocks/transforms and transitive references, and use transparent backgrounds. Every generated document is parsed and validated before return. Sequence wrappers use resolved placement when converted to groups, preserving XSD `sequenceType` auto-placement semantics after sibling removal.
- Expression-bearing nodes are locally promoted to overlay roots because S4 reports expressions without classifying them as unmappable roots. Literal dependency references are retained; external composition dependencies and dynamic/escaped references that cannot be isolated return actionable errors. Parameter references use IDs, per XSD `paramType`.
- Overlay paths sanitize both document stems and subtree IDs. Relative asset paths remain correct for relative and absolute base directories. Referenced audio, including audio reached through definitions, is reported as excluded from the video-only overlay.
- S6 content and other unmapped elements/attributes are counted in the report. Expansion, keyframes, diagnostics and overlay output are bounded.
- The engine must write returned `Overlay.document` bytes to each `Overlay.path` before using the fragment. No new dependencies or assets were added. No external code was borrowed; no attribution update is needed.

Observed TDD red→green log (test names below have prefix `scene_import_`):

- Initial stub: nine failures in `video_settings_assets_and_trailing_blank`, `trim_speed_loop_and_hold`, `snap_audio_and_zero_frame`, `rational_fps`, `background_and_stacking`, `anchor_and_inherited_opacity`, `key_bases_and_loop_keys`, `diagnostics_strict_lenient`, and `overlay_wrappers_assets_order_and_validation`. Import-success assertions received the stub error; strict validation lacked diagnostics. Implementation passed eight; the remaining test helper incorrectly assumed track traversal was chronological and was corrected to sort clips by start.
- Next batch: 13 passed, four failed → 17 passed. `lenient_dispatch_drops_overlay_clips` retained an overlay item; `overlay_sequence_placement_and_transitive_assets` produced `(0,2)` instead of `(3,5)`; `remap_freeze_and_reverse` lacked the expected 3-second hold; `unmapped_counts_and_expression_overlay` returned zero overlays instead of two.
- Next batch: 19 passed, four failed → 23 passed. `image_sequence_declared_metadata` returned zero duration instead of 0.2 seconds; `css_bezier_and_local_keys_under_group_clock` rejected comma-separated controls; `unmapped_attributes_are_counted` lacked `layer@blend`; `overlays_bound_aggregate_work` accepted 1,500 overlays instead of returning an error.
- Next batch: 23 passed, three failed → 26 passed. `background_edges_snap` retained 1.02 seconds instead of snapping to 1.04; `overlay_ancestor_reference_does_not_copy_siblings` copied a sibling; `overlay_external_expression_dependency_refused` incorrectly succeeded.
- `overlay_expression_parameter_closure`: missing-parameter error → pass after resolving parameter IDs.
- Next batch: 27 passed, two failed → 29 passed. `animated_child_parent_limitation_reported` lacked the transform warning; `declared_video_alpha` returned false.
- `overlay_transitive_audio_is_reported`: missing audio warning → pass.
- `overlay_relative_base_paths`: `../project/i.png` instead of `../i.png` → pass.

Supplemental hostile-input, sanitizer, gradient/mute and generated-document tests passed when introduced; they did not each have an independently observed red phase. The importer now has 31 tests, including a proptest configured for 32 generated cases.

Final validation ran exclusively through the VM wrapper:

- Clippy, all targets, `-D warnings`: passed.
- Interchange tests: 153 unit + 59 integration = **212 passed**, zero failures.
- `cargo xtask wasm`: **50 crates passed**.
- Local `git diff --check`: passed.

An earlier Wasm run exhausted VM disk space. Only this agent’s generated target directory was removed; subsequent gates disabled incremental compilation and debug information through environment overrides. The complete final gate passed with those overrides.

No commits were created. The coordination task is archived and all six locks are released.
